name: Franklin Carvajal
office: City of Culver City, Member of the City Council

items.text: Franklin Carvajal is a psychologist and business owner. He says he earned two PhDs from the University of Massachusetts Amherst and Virginia Tech. In a September 2026 candidate forum, he said he wants to be “the person in the middle” and would “shake things up.” He said the city should “start with the small of the small” to help micro-businesses survive, noting that companies like Amazon and Apple are doing fine on their own. In his candidate statement, he lists priorities including public safety, clean streets and parks, peaceful neighborhoods, thoughtful development, green spaces, responsible taxpayer spending, transparent government, and a council that listens to residents.
